name: Sanada Akihiko
source:
Precise height: 175.5 cm

Akihiko is a member of the Shadow Operatives and a former and one of the original members of SEES. Cool and well-respected, Akihiko is serious and determined, as well as cracking small jokes on small occasions (such as with [url=/c53758]Junpei[/url], though this happens not as often), and tends to show his excitement for a big challenge. However, when he is dragged into Junpei's various antics, unlike his usual self, often starts to panic and completely lose his composure (often due to fearing [url=/c51882]Mitsuru's[/url] anger). He also has an aggressive side, which he usually demonstrates when dealing with Shadows. He never gives up and always tries to get stronger in order to protect what is dear to him.

[Edited from [url=http://megamitensei.wikia.com/wiki/Akihiko_Sanada]Megami Tensei Wiki[/url]]

He wields the [Url=https://megamitensei.fandom.com/wiki/Polydeuces]Polydeuces[/url] persona. Polydeuces, aka Pollux, was a hero from Greek mythology. Son of [Url=https://megamitensei.fandom.com/wiki/Zeus]Zeus[/url] and brother to [Url=https://megamitensei.fandom.com/wiki/Castor]Castor[/url], he fused with his brother and was transformed into the [Url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gemini_(constellation)]Gemini constellation[/url] after his brother's death.
